_comment: Sketch only — fill in account/region/ARNs before applying. Not a validated, deployable artifact.
_notes: Redis: use ElastiCache (Redis, cluster-mode disabled is fine for this use case) in the same VPC/subnets; pass REDIS_URL via Secrets Manager. Redis holds ASR sliding-window state, order/attempt metadata, distributed locks, and TPS counters — never card details or session payloads.
SQS: standard queue, one per environment; grant the task role sqs:SendMessage on the queue ARN.

Scaling: the app itself is stateless (all health/order state lives in Redis) so it scales horizontally behind an ALB — target tracking on CPU or request count works well given the sub-20ms routing-decision latency target (selectGateway() only; excludes the actual PG network round trip).
Run at least 2 tasks across 2 AZs for availability; ALB health check should hit GET /healthz.

Webhooks: expose POST /v1/webhooks/:gatewayId behind the same ALB (or a dedicated listener) so gateways can deliver async settlement confirmations; verify each provider's webhook signature before trusting the payload — this sketch does not include that.
